reading.body:
NY4 is a 151,771-square-foot facility in Secaucus, New Jersey, with N+1 redundancy for both power and cooling, configured for a minimum cabinet density of 5 kilowatts per cabinet. Equinix does not publish a megawatt capacity figure for this building, so its power envelope cannot be directly compared to other facilities in this registry.

Equinix describes NY4 as part of its largest New York metro site, serving financial, media, and enterprise customers with colocation, advertising exchange services, and cloud connectivity. The facility sits within a ten-building metro cluster spanning New Jersey and upstate New York, suggesting significant depth of interconnection at the metro level rather than concentration of capacity in a single building.

Within New Jersey, 48 facilities are mapped in this registry and only 5 publish power capacity figures totaling 111.3 megawatts. NY4 ranks sixth by published megawatt capacity in the state, but since Equinix has not published its capacity for this specific building, its actual position in New Jersey's power hierarchy cannot be determined from available data.
